libjpeg-turbo 3.2.0
https://github.com/libjpeg-turbo/libjpeg-turbo/releases/tag/3.2.0

This software is based in part on the work of the Independent JPEG Group.

The unmodified libjpeg API sources are statically linked into the application's
row-based JPEG encoder. See LICENSE.md and README.ijg in this directory for
the original copyright notices, license terms and warranty disclaimers.
